name: Pending Inward Documents
query:
SELECT
  inv.sender AS "Sender:Data:150",
  inv.maa_code AS "Maa Code:Link/Student:120",
  inv.subject AS "Subject:Data:150",
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN det.document_name = 'Application' THEN 'Pending' END), '') AS "Application:Data:100",
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN det.document_name = 'Leaving Certificate' THEN 'Pending' END), '') AS "Leaving Certificate:Data:120",
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN det.document_name = 'Fee receipt/Bonafide' THEN 'Pending' END), '') AS "Fee Receipt/Bonafide:Data:130",
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN det.document_name = 'SSC Marksheet' THEN 'Pending' END), '') AS "SSC Marksheet:Data:120",
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN det.document_name = 'HSC Marksheet' THEN 'Pending' END), '') AS "HSC Marksheet:Data:120",
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN det.document_name = 'Current study Marksheet Marksheet' THEN 'Pending' END), '') AS "Current Study Marksheet:Data:160",
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN det.document_name = 'Proof of Resident' THEN 'Pending' END), '') AS "Proof of Resident:Data:130",
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN det.document_name = 'Proof of Income' THEN 'Pending' END), '') AS "Proof of Income:Data:130",
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN det.document_name = 'Student Bank Passbook' THEN 'Pending' END), '') AS "Bank Passbook:Data:130"
FROM `tabInward Document` inv
INNER JOIN `tabInward Details` det ON det.parent = inv.name
WHERE det.received = 0
  AND inv.subject IN ('Udaan - Application', 'Vidhya - Application')
GROUP BY inv.name
HAVING COUNT(det.name) > 0
ORDER BY inv.sender
